name: krakenwhip
summary: Deploy AI stacks with one command — OpenClaw, Ollama, and Qdrant, fully containerized. Install: pip install krakenwhip. Run: krakenwhip deploy openclaw; then docker exec -it krakenwhip-openclaw openclaw tui for the TUI. Default LLM: Anthropic (Claude) when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set; Ollama (Llama 3.2) as fallback.
